name: Finn Jones

subheadline: Building modern web and software solutions — currently pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Science & Commerce (Finance) at UNSW.
about: I'm a well-rounded engineer with a dual degree in Computer Science and Commerce (Finance) from UNSW. I combine deep technical knowledge with financial insight, building innovative software solutions and contributing to open-source projects on GitHub.

With experience spanning IT support, freelance development, and enterprise software engineering, I bring a unique perspective to every project — from low-level infrastructure to polished user experiences.

highlights: Building and maintaining software products in the mortgage and lending space
Working with modern web technologies and agile workflows
Automated device management, reducing manual work and boosting efficiency
Managed 2,000+ devices with JAMF, ensuring performance, security, and minimal downtime
Resolved tech support tickets promptly, minimizing impact on productivity
Strong stakeholder management with students, teachers, and parents
Client training and support, project management, and custom web design for small businesses
